T:P1.7.text: Marc Jacobs is an iconic American fashion house known for its fearless designs and playful approach to luxury. Marc Jacobs continues to influence the world of fashion with its innovative vision and bold approach to style.

T:P1.9.text: the House of Karl Lagerfeld shares the iconic vision and design aesthetic of its namesake, fused with a contemporary, forward-looking spirit.
